requestBody.description: Entity with every possible validation type

UserRegistration.description: Tests string validators: minLength, maxLength, pattern, format(email/uri), default

username.description: Username: 3-30 chars, starts with letter, alphanumeric + underscore/dash

password.description: Password: 8-128 chars, must contain lower + upper + digit

phone.description: Phone in E.164 format - tests pattern only (no length)

website.description: Personal website URL - tests format(uri) + maxLength

Product.description: Tests numeric validators: minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum(bool), exclusiveMaximum(bool), multipleOf, default, plus string pattern

price.description: Price: >0 and <=999999.99 - tests exclusiveMinimum(bool=true) with minimum

quantity.description: Stock quantity: 0-10000 - tests minimum + maximum + default

weight.description: Weight in kg: 0.01-1000, step 0.01 - tests multipleOf

rating.description: Rating: 0 <= r < 5 - tests exclusiveMaximum(bool=true) with maximum

discountPercent.description: Discount: 0-100, multiples of 5 - tests multipleOf on integer

SearchCriteria.description: Tests array validators: minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, plus nested $ref

PriceRange.description: Nested object with numeric validators - tests nested $ref propagation

AuditRecord.description: Tests readOnly, writeOnly, nullable, enum, default

id.description: Auto-generated ID (readOnly - excluded from input forms)

secret.description: Auth token (writeOnly - never returned in responses)

severity.description: Severity 1-5, default 3 - tests min + max + default

expiresInHours.description: Expiration in hours (1-8760, multiples of 24, default 720)

BaseAddress.description: Base address for allOf composition - has its own validators

ValidatedAddress.description: Tests allOf merge: BaseAddress validators + extension validators must all propagate

FullValidationEntity.description: Single schema exercising EVERY validator type supported by YASAG

requiredString.description: [required + minLength + maxLength] Non-empty string up to 255

patternField.description: [required + pattern + minLength + maxLength] Code like AB1234C

multipleOfField.description: [required + multipleOf + min + max] Quarters from 0 to 100
